kun mkhyen gsung 'bum bayang dag par/ zhes pa nas/ mkhyen cing gzigs pa des der rab tu byung ba la bsnyen par ldogs pa'i dge slong gi ltang bar gyur pa'i chos bzhi gsungs te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ phrog gcod pa/ ma byin par len pa/ mi tshangs par spyod pa/ rdzun du smra ba bzhi slongs dgos par gsungs pas ji ltar khyod gnas 'di lta bu la mi spyod dam/ des mi spyod lags bya/ yang bcom ldan 'das/ zhes ba nas/ gzigs pa des de ltar rab tu byung ba dang / bsnyen par ljags pa la dge sbyong du byed pa'i chos bzhi gsungs te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ gshe yang slar mi gshe/ khos yang slar mi kho/ bdegs kyang slar mi brdegs/ mtshang brus kyang slar mtshangs mi 'bru ba des ji ltar khyod gnas 'di lta bu la spyod dam/ des spyod lags/ zhes brjod/ de dag ni kho bos khyod la bslab pa'i gzhi che long rags rim tsam zhig brjod pa yin gyis/ rgyas par ni rang gi 'dul pa'i sde snod sogs dang zla ba phyed phyed cing so sor thar pa'i mdo 'don pa las kyang shes par bya dgos/ mdor na don hril gyi dril na/ bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pa'i dge slong gis gang la bslab par bya ba de la/ de ring bsnyen par ljags pa'i dge slong gis kyang slob/ de ring gi bsnyen par ljags pa'i dge slong gis gang la bslab par bya ba de la/ bsnyen par rogs nas lo brgya lon pa'i dge slong gis kyang slob dgos pa'i da zugs la bzhag nas phyag len la zeb par mdzod/ khyod kyi dge slong gi sdom pa thong pa de/ mkhan po'i bka' drin las byung ba yin te/ mkhan po rang gis bgyis par 'os pa rnams rang gi bgyis/ gzhan la bcol 'os pa rnams gzhan la bcol ba las grub pa yin pas/ mkhan po'i lhungags la yar phyag gsum 'tshol la/ mkhan 16 rin 〈sna che bka' drin che lags/ zhes brjod cing / de ltar byas ba dang /dge 'dun rnams kyis me tog gtogazhon lam bzhi btab/ bslab pa gsum ldan sogs dang / khrims kyi tshul khrims skyongan med cing / /zhesasogs kyang brjod/ 'dul ba gya mtsho'i gling nas legs rgyungaba'i/ /yid bzhin nor 4'i cho ga rnam dag 'di/ /rjedadaka'i dal 'byor bum bzang lta bu 'di/ /rnam dag tshul khrims nor gyis gang bar 62

kun mkhyen gsung 'bum bargyas kyi sa'i bar byed dgos so/ /gsum pa rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes ston par/ rang byung bdag nyid rtogs pa'i spras /la/n+d+ra sna/༵ ༵ (spri ( /lha ༷ ༷sa dīnā r+nghi/ma/spra lha /springapa/ngaXni ru (( n+dha dī sdipa kāshā rnyi ched du dmigs pa skye mched bcu gnyis la dmigs nas rnam pa gzung bya phyi don gyis dbe+en bar mngon sum du rtogs pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags lam de/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ dbye na mthong sgom mi slob lam gsum yod/ gsum pa ni/ sa mtshams theg chen mthong lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod/bzhi pa theg chen mthong lam phan yon dang bcas pa ston par/ bden dang bden la bzod pa dang / /nas/ lam shes nyid kyi skad cig ma/ /zhes gsungs/ theg chen gyi mthong lam la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams gsum/ dang po ni/ srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis 'gog pa'i bden pa mngon rtogs de theg chen mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ dbye na/ mnyam bzhag ye shes dang / rjes thob ye shes gnyis/ rtogs rigs kyis phye na rang yin pa'i nyan thos kyi lam shes ba'i mthong lam/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i mthong lam/ theg chen gyi lam shes pa'i mthong lam gsum dang / dmigs pa dang ldog pas pye na bzod pa brgyad dang / shes pa brgyad de bcu drug yod do/ /gsum pa sa mtshams mthong lam kho nar yod/lnga pa sgom lam gyi byed pa ston par/ kun nas zhi dang thams cad la/ /nas/ byang chub dang ni rten mtshod nyid/ /ces gsungs/ theg chen sgom lam gyi byed pa la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams gsum/ dang po ni/ theg chen sgom lam bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i phan yon 76
don bdun cu'i mtha'adaphyod/de/ theg chen sgom lam gyi byed pa'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa dbye na drug yod de/ kun nas nga rgyal sogs zhi ba'i byed pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du 'dud pa'i byed pa dang /nyon yongs las nges par rgyal ba'i byed pa dang / gnod bas mi brdziba'i byed pa dang / yang dag cags pa'i byang chub kyi byed pa dang / sher phyin rten pa'i yul mchod par bya ba nyid du byed pa'i sgom lam byed pa ste drug yod/ gsum pa ni/ sa mtshams sa dang po nas bcu pa'i bar yod/drug pa sgom lam la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams gsum/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de/ zeg chen sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ rjes la mngon rtogs dang sgom lam don gcig /gnyis pa ni dbye na zag bcas sgom lam dang zag med sgom lam gnyis/dang po dang rtog par gyur pa'i sgom lam don gcig /gnyis pa dang rtog bral gyi sgom lam don gcig /dang po la mos bsngo rjes su yi rang ba'i sgom lam gsum yod/ dang po mos pa sgom lam ston par/ mos pa rang gi don dang ni/ /nas/ rnam pa nyi shu bdun du 'dod/ /ces gsungs/yum don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i dad pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de/ theg chen gyi mos pa sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na rang don mos pa'i de/gnyis don mos pa'i de/ gzhan don mos pa'i de gsum/ de re re la'ang chung ngu 'bring chen po gsum ste dgu dang / de re re la'ang chung ngu'i chung ngu sogs gsum gsum phye bas nyer bdun yod/ sa mtshams sa dang po nas sa bcu ba'i bar du yod/bdun pa de'i phan yon bstod bkur bsngags gsum ston par/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa la/ /nas/ bkur ba dang ni bsngags par 'dod/ /ces gsungs/ mos pa sgom lam gsum sgom pa'i byang sems la sangs rgyas byang sems gong ma rnams dgyes pa'i cha dang de'i don gnas kyi yon tan brjod ba'i cha gang rung gis bsdus pa'i yon tan de/ mos pa sgom lam gyi phan yon 77
kun mkhyen gsung 'dum babstod bkur bsngags gsum gyis bsdus pa'i phan yon gyi mtshan nyid du 'jog /dbye na nyer bdun yod/ sa mtshams mos pa dang 'dra/brgyad pa bsngo ba sgom lam ston par/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can/ /nas/ bsod nams che 'byung bdag nyid do/ /zhes tshigs bcad gsum byung / rang gzhan sgyi dge rtsardzogs hā/ sbyi pa/ parnyi hā ñjashā rnyiswā sno rnyi/ the/ mi baX shārnyi ༵ sna( / rtoshādri nywa /sna kā dā/da pa/ can gyi sgom lam dang / dmigs med rnam pa can sgya bsngo ba sgom lam dang gnyis/ phyin ci ma log pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi bsngo ba sgom lam dang gsum/ dben pa'i bsngo ba sgom lam dang bzhi/ sangs rgyas bsemad nams rang bzhin dran pa'i bsngo ba sgom lam dang / thabs la mkhas pa'i bsngo ba sgom lam dang / mtshan ma med pa'i bsngo ba sgom lam dang / sangs rgyas kyi rjes su gnang ba'i bsngo ba sgom lam dang / khams gsum du gtogs pa ma yin pa'i bsngo ba sgom lam dang / bsod nams chen po 'byung ba'i bsngo ba chung ngu'i sgom lam dang / bsod nams chen po'i 'bring gi bsngo ba sgom lam dang / bsod nams chen po'i bsngo ba chen po'i sgom lam dang bcu gnyis yod do/ /sa mtshams sa dang po nas bcu pa'i bar ro/ /dgu pa rjes su yi rang sgom lam ston par/ thabs dang mi dmigs pa dag gis/ /nas/sgom pa yin par 'dir brjod do/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad gcig byung / rang gzhan gyi dge ba la mngon par dga' ba'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs rtog bcas de/ theg chen gyi rjes su yi rang sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na rang gzhan gyi dge ba la yi rang gnyis sam kun theb dang don dam pa'i yul can gyi yi rang gnyis yod/ mos bsngo yi rang gi sgom lam gsum gyi sa macanams 'dra/78
don bdun cu'i mtha'adapyod/pa don smin rnyi /ba ༵ spya r+sha pā ka kau cirnyi byu/ spra /sdishā sbyo dze+e )lha spya/ k+to rje/ sa/na ༵ ma/ (sna ṭ+wāṃ snashā shāX spri ༷/ pyā s+t+ri wa ) snye /tram̐ ༷ sde/ snye // ñcha ngh+ru ༷༷ shaṃ /khro/ gtod pa dang / sgom lam des 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob pa'i don chen po nyid dang lnga yod pa'i pyir/ sa mtshams sa dang po nas bcu pa'i bar ro/ /bcu gcig pa rnam dag sgom lam la mtshan nyid dbye ba dang bcas ston par/ 'bras bu dag pa gzugs la semags/ /nas/ canags pa'i lam ni dag pa yin/ /zhes zug lo ka gsum byung / zag med theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs gang spangs pa mthar thug gi lag rjes 'jog byed de/ theg chen gyi rnam dag sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ sgom spang skor dgu'i gnyen po skor dgu yod/ sgom spang chen po'i chen po'i gnyen bo/ nas/ chung ngu'i chung ngu'i gnyen po rnam dag sgom lam chen po'i chen po'i bar dgu yod/ sa mtshams sa dang po nas sa bcu pa'i bar du yod/ lam shes mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig bshad zin to/ /gsum pa gzhi shes mtshon byed kyi chos dgu ston par/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing / /nas/ de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod/ /ces sogs lhasto lo ka gnyis byung / gzhi shes mtshon byed kyi tshos dgu yod de/ shes pas srid la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes dang / snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa'i lam shes dang / 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes dang / 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes dang / mtshan 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang / mtshan 79
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ba'dzin gyi gnyen pos zin pa'i gnyen po phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang / gzhi shes sbyor ba dang / sbyor ba'i latshen stangs mnyam pa nyid dang / mthong lam dang dgu yod pa'i pyir/ dang po ni/ tshur rol pha rol mtha' la min/ /sogs lhasto lo ka gcig byung / srid mtha' la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid ni/ thabs snying rje chen pos zin cing mi rtag sogs gang rung mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na mthong sgom mi slob lam gsum yod/ mtshan gzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen sgom lam lta bu/ yang kun rob la nyos pa'i zhi mtha' 'gog byed kyi rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs de/ snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi theg chen sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi snying rje lta bu/ snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes mi rung bas snga ma dang mi 'dra'o/ /dbye na/ theg chen 'phags pa'i snying rje chen po gsum dang sems bskyed sogs yod/ 'di gnyis kyi sa mtshams sa dang po nas sa bcu pa'i bar du yod/gsum pa 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes ston par/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas/ /thabs ma yin pas ring ba ste/ /zhes gsungs/ de la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams gsum/ dang po ni/ mi rtag sogs mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes gang / snying rje chen po dang bral zhing bden 'dzin gyis bcings ba'i gzhi shes de 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na nyan rang rgyud kyi mi rtag sogs rtogs pa'i gzhi shes sogs yod/ sa mtshams zeg dman mthong lam nas dgra bcom pa'i bar du yod/bzhi pa 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes ston par/ de ni thabs la mkhas pa yis yang dag nye ba nyid du bshad/ /ces gsungs/ de la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams gsum/ dang 80
don bdun cu'i mtha'adaphyod/po ni/ snying rje chen po dang stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab gnyis kyis zin pa'i mi rtag sogs gang rung rtogs pa'i zeg dman rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de/ 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ dbye na/ theg chen gyi mthong sgom mi slob lam gsum yod/ gsum pa ni/ sa mtshams theg chen mthong lam nas sangs rgyas skya sa'i bar ro/ /lnga pa mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes ston par/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang / /nas/spyod pa'i 'du shes mi mthun phyogs/ /zhes gsungs/ thabs snying rje chen po dang stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang bral zhing bden 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i theg dman gyi gzhi shes de mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ theg dman gyi lam byang sems kyis skyed mi rung bas mi mthun phyogs zer ro/ /dbye ba sa mtshams rnams ring ba'i gzhi shes dang 'dra'o/ /drug pa gnyen po phyogs kyi gzhi shes ston par/ sbyin la sogs la ngar 'dzin med/ /nas/de ni bsam mi khyab par 'dod/ /ces sho lo ka gsum dang rkang pa gcig byung / thabs snying rje chen po dang stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i theg chen 'phags rgyud kyi gzhi shes de/ gnyen po phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye ba sa mtshams 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes dang 'dra'o/ /gzhi shes la dbye na 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes dang / de la ring ba'i gzhi shes gnyis yod/ zeg dman sngon song ma byas na 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes dang / thabs la mkhas pas nye ba'i gzhi shes dang / gnyen po phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang theg chen gzhi shes rnams don gcig /'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes/ thabs ma yin pas ring ba'i gzhi shes/ mtshan 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i gzhi shes/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes/theg dman gzhi shes rnams don gcig ste/ de ltar kun shes nyid lugs la/ /nas/ ji skad bshad 81
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum bapa 'dir shes bya/ /zhes gsungs/ 'grel chen las/ 'di dag ni nyan thos dang byang chub sems (shā tsā ༵ snatsho ṭ+wāṃ rnyiji dz+nyo shā rnyi( dī/ shā lta( (shārnyi /lha rdzug rdo traṃ dh+ri ༈ ṭ+wāṃ pa/ / shā lha pa nyid kyis spang bar bya ba yin pa'i phyir de byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mi mthun phyogs yin par bstan pa'i phyir/ zhes zug/ /bdun pa gzhi shes spyor ba ston par/ gzugs sogs de mi rtag sogs dang / /nas/ snang ba rnam bdun shes byed do/ /zhes sho lo ka gnyis dang rkang ba gnyis byung / de la mtshan nyid/dbye ba/ sa mtshams gsum/ dang bo ni/ gzhi kun rjob pa'i sdod lugs kyi ngo bo dang khyad par la phyin ci log tu zhen pa'i gnyen po theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'gror de/ 'dir bstan gzhi shes sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ dbye na bcu yod de/gzugs sogs la bden zhen bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang / khyad chos de mi rtag pa sogs la bden zhen bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang / gzugs sogs de yon tan sgya rten du ma rdzogs pa dang ljags pa'i sbyor ba dang / gzugs sogs de la bden zhen gyi chags med kyi sbyor ba snye yul gyi sgos bzhi dang /don dam par sher phyin 'phel 'grib mi 'gyur ba'i sbyor ba dang / byed pa po don dam par med pa'i sbyor ba dang / bya dka' ba rnam gsum gyi sbyor ba dang / don dam par med kyang tha snyad du 'bras bu yod pa'i sbyor ba dang / phan yon che ba'i byang chub gzhan la rag ma las pa'i sbyor ba dang / bden par med kyang mngon zhen gyi snang ba rmi lam sogs shes byed snang ba rnam bdun gyi spyor ba dang bcu yod pa'i phyir/ rnam bshad dang tshig mi mthun kyang gser 'phreng dang nyi snang ltar yin pas don mthun no/ /gsum pa ni/ sa mtshams tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar te/ gser 'phreng las/ 'di kha cig sbyor lam du 'dod kyang tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i 82
don bdun cu'i mtha'adaphyod/bar na yod do zhes so/ /brgyad pa sbyor ba de'i 'dzin stangs mnyam nyid ston par/ gzugs la sogs la rlom med pa/ /rnam bzhi de yi mnyam pa nyid/ /ces gsungs/ de la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams gsum/ dang po ni/ gzhi shes sbyor ba sgom pa'i rnam pa gang yul dang yul can du rlom pa 'gog byed de/ sbyor ba de'i 'dzin stangs mnyam nyid kyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis ba ni/ dbye na sbyor ba de bcu la rlom med bzhi bzhi ste bzhi bcu yod de/ nyi snang las/ ji ltar na rnam pa bzhi gang yin zhe na/gzugs rlom sems su mi byed/ gzugs kyis rlom su mi byed/ gzugs bdag gi zhes bya bar rlom sems su mi byed/ gzugs la rlom sems su mi byed/ ces gang gsungs pa zhes 31/ /gsum pa ni/ sa mtshams tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar sla/kyi ska/ sprisna snathor+sha dīsna nywa snakā/smaṃ ga k+ṣiṃ sna pa ṭ+wāṃ k+ṣiṃ rnyiXn dpa ༵/la/ parnyi/ bsdi/ shā paspri( rtogs de/ mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na theg pa gsum gyi mthong lam gsum/ ldog pas phye nas 'dir bstan skad cig ma bcu drug gsungs so/ /mtshon g+ni ༵/༵ n+dha 35 spyan pa/shā pa/lha 〉pa ༵ shārnyi (panya/ spru/ r+sha ji ༵༵ gurnyiji (tā yid 'phrog 'phags bzhi'i yum ngo mtshar/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad de/ mkhyen gsum mtshon byed kyi chos bshad zin rto/ /gnyis pa sbyor bzhi mtshon pa'i chos so drug bshad pa la/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba mtshon pa'i chos bcu gcig dang / rtse sbyor mtshon pa'i chos brgyad dang / mthar gyis sbyor ba mtshon pa'i chos bcu gsum/ skad cig sbyor mtshon pa'i chos bzhi bshad pa bzhi/ dang bo ston par/83
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum barnam pa sbyor bar bcas rnams dang / /nas/ 'di ni thabs la mkhas pa yin/ /zhes gsungs/mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa brgya dang casan gsum nyams su len pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de rnam ljags spyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ byang sems kyi lam dang / lam sher phyin (rmis/ lha/ lha (lha'i k+ṣiṃ shā ༵ /hā /sgo/dri ༵ k+ham̐ lha( dī /dri / k+ṣiṃ ༷pa shāshā (( / shā sgru mtshams theg chen tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar du yod/ rnam ljags sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi tshos bcu gcig yod de/ rnam pa dang / sbyor ba dang / yon tan dang / sbyor ba'i skyon dang / mtshan nyid dang / thar pa cha mthun dang / nges 'byed cha mthun dang / slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun dang / srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba dang / zhing dag sbyor ba dang / thabs mkhas sbyor ba ste bcu gcig yod pa'i phyir/ dang po ston par/ gzhi shes pa yi bye brag rnams/ /nas/ sum cu tshadagu dag tu bzhed/ /ces gsungs/ 'dir bstan rnam pa la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni//lha/ spyaX sh+lau /| hūm̐ smaṃ dī/ ṭ+wāṃ stuX staX/ hūm̐ ༷༷ pya ༷༷ ༷ dī two /ṣ+ṭaṃ tram̐ two ༷༷༷ bcu yod pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po grub ste/ bden bzhi'i bden pa dang po gsum gyi steng gi rnam pa bzhi bzhi dang lam bden steng gi rnam pa bco lnga dang nyer bdun yod de/ med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste/ /nas/ lam la de ni bco lngar bshad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ rgyu kun 'byung bden pa'i steng gi rnam pa brgyad dang / lam bden gyi steng gi rnam pa bdun swāhā /)sdig zlo /spya ñjadī shā /lha lha rtswa (shā /dpagog ༵na hā/ dzob /madru dhi rnyiX spyasgra |( ṇā ga dz+nyo 84
don bdun cu'i mtha' dargyad/gsungs/ rtags gsum pa grub ste/ slob ma nyan thos dang rtogs rigs shun mong ba'i gzhi shes kyi rnam pa byang phyogs so bdun dang / byang sems dang rtogs rigs thun mong ba'i lam shes kyi rnam pa so bzhi/ rnam mkhyen gyi thun yong ma yin pa'i rnam pa sum cu rtsadagu dang brgya rtsabacu yod de/ dran pa nyer bzhag nas bzung ste/ /nas/ sum cu rtsadagu dag tu bzhed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ shes rnam la don rnam sngon du shes dgos pas sngon la don rnam bshad pa sla'o/ /gnyis pa sbyor ba ston par/ gzugs la serdzogs la mi gnas phyir/ /nas/ de ni dag pa mtshams dang bcas/ /zhes gsungs/ sbyongar ba la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams gsum/ dang po ni/ yul yul can dang gzhi lam rnam gsum bden stong du rtogs pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel de/dngos bstan gtso bo'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa ji snyed pa la zhi lhag zung 'brel thob pa'i shes rab gyis zin pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ 'dir bstan sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid byas na legs te/ tshegs chen yun ring rtogs pa'i sbyor ba tshogs lam nas 'jog dgos shing 'di'i dbye ba yin pa'i phyir te/ nyi snang las/ sbyor ba ma yin pa byed pa nyid kyis ni las dang po ba tshegs chen pos dang zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / rnam bshad gser 'phreng (snashā sminārī lha /pa /zhedzo rmo pa/ /tsho tsho r+ṣi ༷shā / /ār+shaswā r+shadī dwo pasdi( snashā dkag pa'i sbyor ba dang / gzugs sogs gzhi'i de nyid rtogs pa'i zab pa'i sbyor ba dang / lam gyi chos kyi rang bzhin rtogs pa'i gting dpag dka' ba'i sbyor ba dang / gzugs sogs kyi rnam pa'i rang bzhin tshad med pa rtogs pa'i tshad med pa'i sbyor ba lnga ngo bo'i sgos dang / stong nyid zab mo la skrag pas las dang po ba byang chub yun ring po nas rtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang / drod nas chos nyid la mi skrag shing rmi lam na yang phyin drug spyod pa'i lung bstan thob pa'i sbyor ba dang / rtse85
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum bamo nas chos nyid rtogs pa'i yum rang la byung bas phyir mi ldog brtan pa'i sbyor ba dang / bzod pa nas thabs shes kyi rtogs pa brtan po nyan rang gi bar chad las 'das pa nges bar 'grang ba'i sbyor ba dang / chos mchog nas chos dbyings mngon sum du mthong ba'i rgya mtshor 'jug par mthong nas bar med pa dang bcas pa'i sbyor ba dang / rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu zag med kyi chos gsar pa skye rung ba'i byang chub nye ba'i sbyor ba dang / 'bras bu myur du 'byung ba'i myur bar 'tshang rgya ba'i sbyor ba dang / snying rjes gzhan don du chos kyi gangor lo bskor ba la 'jug pa gzhan don gyi sbyor ba dang brgyad po 'di rten gang zag sgos dang / don dam par skyon dang yon tan 'phel med 'grib med du rtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang / don dam par dge sogs chos dang chos min pa sogs mi mthong ba'i sbyor ba dang / gzugs sogs la bden bar rlom pa med pa'i bsam mi khyab kyis mi mthong ba'i sbyor ba dang / gzugs sogs mtshan mtshon du bden par mi rtogs pas rnam par mi rtog ba'i sbyor ba dang bzhi ni yum sgom pa ljags pa'i thabs kyi sgos dang / yon tan 'phel bar byed pa 'bras bu rin chen sbyin pa'i sbyor ba dang / nyes ba sel bar byed pa rnam par dag pa'i sbyor ba dang gnyis ni 'bras bu'i sgos dang / yum myur du sgom pa'i sa mtshams kyi sbyor ba dang nyi shu yod pa'i phyir/gsum pa sbyor ba'i yon tan ston par/ bdud kyi mthu bcom la sogs pa/ /yon tan rnam pa bcu bzhi 'o/ /zhes gsungs/ sbyor ba bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i phan yon de/ sbyor ba'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bcu bzhi yod/ sbyor ba ste sher phyin 'dri 'don sgom pa la sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs pas bar chad bdud kyi mthu bcom pa dang / sbyor ba bsgoms pa dgongs shang mkhyen pa'i yon tan dang / sangs rgyas kyis mngon sum du mdzad pa'i yon tan dang / yang dag par ljags pa'i byang chub dang nye bar gyur pa'i yon tan dang /don che ba nyid la 86

kun mkhyen gsung 'bum bala mkhas pa rnam pa bcu/ /zhes gsungs/ thabs mkhas sbyongar ba la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams gsum/ dang po ni/ 'bad rtsol rags pa zhi ba'i sgo nas 'phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i dag sa'i sems dpa'i ye shes de/ thabs mkhas sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ dbye na bcu yod de/ bar chad kyi chos las 'das pa'i thabs mkhas sbyor ba dang / mi gnas pa'i thabs mkhas sbyor ba dang / smon lam gyi shugs kyis 'phangs pa'i ye shes dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i de dang / ma chags pa'i de dang / mi dmigs pa'i de dang / mtshan ma med pa'i de dang /smon pa med pa'i de dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags kyi de dang / tshad med pa'i thabs mkhas sbyor ba dang bcu 6(da pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sa mtshams sa brgyad pa nas rgyun mtha'i bar du yod/rnam cags sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa rtse sbyor mtshon byed kyi chos brgyad ston par/ de yi rtags dang rnam 'phel dang / /nas/ rtse mo'i mngon rtogs/ zhes gsungs/ rtse sbyor mtshon pa'i chos brgyad yod de/drod tshesbyor/ rtsemo'i 〉sbyor/ bzod pa'i rtse sbyor/ chos mchog gi 〉sbyor/ mthong lam 〉sbyor/kau ༵ lhad r+nghi trā/ (( spya ༷tsho shā 〉〉 /༵ pa~X lcag sdipa da( ༵ m+p+raṃ ༷༷ r+sharnyiX snor+sha/ tu bzhed/ /ces gsungs/drod 〉sbyor la gsum las/ dang po ni/ rmi lam na yang chos thams cad rmi lam lta bur lta ba sogs de'i rtags bcu gnyis gang rung thob pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i sems dpa'i nges 'byed cha mthun de/drod 〉sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ dbye na drod chung 'bring che gsum yod/ gsum pa ni/ sa mtshams drod na yod/ gnyis pa rtse mo'i rtse sbyor ston par/ 'dzam bu gling gi skye bo snyed/ /nas/ rnal 'phel bcu drug bdag nyid do/ /zhes gsungs/rtse mo'i 6sbyor la gsum las/ dang po ni/ bsod nams rnam par 'phel ba bcu drug tshang ba'i 96
don bdun cu'i mtha'adaphyod/rigs gnas kyi theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun gnyis pa de/ rtsemo'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/de dang zeg chen gyi sbyor lam rtsemo don gcig/gnyis pa ni/ dbye na/ rtsemo'i 〉sbyor chung 'bring che gsum yod/ gsum pa ni/ sa mtshams zeg chen gyi sbyor lam rtse mo na yod/gsum pa bzod pa'i rtse sbyor ston par/ kun mkhyen nyid gsum chos rnams kyi/ /nas/brtan pa zhes ni mngon par brjod/ /ces gsungs/ bzod pa'i rtse spyor la gsum las/ dang po ni/ mkhyen gsum rjes mthun pa ljags pa'i shes rab dang gzhan don la mi phyed pa'i thabs brtan po thob pa'i nges 'byod cha mthun gsum pa de/ bzod pa'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ de dang theg chen gyi sbyor lam bzod pa don gcig /6sbyor snga ma gnyis la'ang 'di ltar sems dpa'i ma sbyar na'ang rung lte/ theg dman la de 'dra'i sbyor lam med pa'i phyir/ de ltar na'ang dogs pa sel sla ched du sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dbye na/zeg chen gyi bzod pa chung 'bring che gsum yod/gsum pa ni/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi sbyor lam bzod pa bzhin no/ /bzhi pa chos mchog gi rtse sbyor ston par/ gling bzhi pa dang stong dag dang / /nas/ ting 'dzin yongs su bsgrags pa yin/ /zhes gsungs/ chos mchog gi rtse sbyor la gsum las/dang po ni/ mthong lam skyed pa'i nus ldan gyi ting nge 'dzin mtha'alpus pas sems kun tu gnas pa thob pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun bzhi pa de/ chos mtshog gi rtse sbyor gyi mtshananyid/ gnyis pa ni/ dbye na/ theg chen sgya bh+yor lam chos mchog chung 'bring che gsum yod/ gsum pa ni/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos mchog dang 'dra/'dir dī stang paXng tsham 〉zhe sprar gnāpar/ /ma~X pa~X spyazlo/ spra pa~X la/ sa/na/ji/nga( sdis ༵ spri spang bden 'dzin gyi gnyen po byed pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs 97
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum bade/ mthong lam 〉sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ de dang theg chen gyi mthong lam don gcig /gnyis pa ni/ dbye na mnyam rjes gnyis dang / spang bya'i sgos mthong spang rnam rtog bzhi'i gnyen po mthong lam tshesbyor bzhi dang / mnyam bzhag ye shes la shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug yod/ gsum pa ni/ sa mtshams zeg chen gyi mthong lam dang 'dra'o/ /drug pa sgom lam 〉sbyor ston par/ 'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur/ /nas/mi mthun phyogs gzhan rnam pa dgu/zhes gsungs/ sgom lam tshesbyor la gsum las/ dang 〈sna /nye/ sna m+bhi rnyilha stam+bha dī sdidī 1sna/ ༵ r+sha k+ṣiṃ ba~X snyepa ༵ dī dzo / dri pa lha lham spa (spya gh+nā zloX gyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ dbye na sgom spang rnam rtog skor dgu'i dngos gnyen bar chad med lam skor dgu dang / sgom lam rnam grol lam sgor dgu yod/ gsum pa ni/ sa mtshams sa dang po nas bcu pa'i bar du yod/bdun pa bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor ston par/ stong gsum skye bo nyan thos dang / /nas/bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /zhes gsungs/ bar chad med pa'i tshesbyor la mtshan nyid/ dbye dī/khye/ pa( dīX gh+nā stapa/ zlas bo hūm̐ skye/ pasnro sbrispridī lhaspri /shā ༵ m+p+raṃ mi sna hūm̐ /ji 'dīpa /lha med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ de dang rgyun mtha'i ye shes don gcig /gnyis pa ni/ dbye na/skad cig sbyor bzhi yod/ gsum pa ni/ sa mtshams rgyun mtha' kho na yin no/ /pa bcub ḍā r+yaṃ k+ṣiṃ r+sha rtswa loX ñjar+sha āX par/bshāX sbyi rnyilha rnyishā ṭ+wāṃ dī ༷shā ṭ+wāṃ// //rdzu ba/ /rnapa mtshams gsum/ dang po ni/ bden gnyis ngo bo gcig la 'du mi rung bar 'dzin pa'i sa bon 98
don bdun cu'i mtha'adaphyod//sna dz+nyo sdi rgyuX gh+nā dī shāshā two /pa( pa~X /sadzo spya (shā dī dzo tā //rnatsho ༵ ༵ /nga/ ṣ+ṭṛ ṭ+wāṃ /garnyishā dang / lam bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu mi rung snyam pa dang / gzhi'i don dam gyi sgo nas kun yab sun 'byin pa dang / kun cab sgos don dam sun 'gyen pa'i rtsod pa gnyis dang / spyod pa'i ngo bo sgyin sogs mi 'thad par thal ba gcig dang / spyod pa'i rten sangs rgyas mi 'thad par thal ba dang / chos mi 'thad par thal ba dang / dge 'dun mi 'thad par thal ba gsum dang / spyod pa'i khyad par thabs mkhas pa mi 'thad par thal ba dang / mngon rtogs mi 'thad par thal ba dang /de'i spang bya rtog pa mi 'thad par thal ba gnyis dang / lam gyi ngo 11 mi 'thad par thal ba gcig dang / spang gnyen gyi dbye ba mi 'thad par thal ba gcig dang / bsgom bya rang sgyi mi 'thad par thal ba gcig dang / sgom pa mi 'thad par thal ba ste bcu drug yod pa'i phyir/ de ltar 'dzin pa'i spriX / ṣ+ṭaṃ 33 two shā ṣ+yo two /spu / two ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ༷rmo m+p+raṃ lci/ nywa| dwo/ ba/ gh+nā/spya ṭ+wāṃ ṣ+ṭaṃ ṭ+wāṃ gang rung rgyu mtshan du byas nas cig shos sun 'byon pa'i rtsod ngag de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/spra r+shak+ta sdu/ / sna rdzoshā sh+lau ṭ+wāṃ dz+nyo kau 335 55 ṭ+wāṃ zhu/ // /dri spra // m+p+raṃ pa/sna sbyo rdo/ du yod de/ sa bon yang der bshad pas sgom spang yod pa'i phyir/ rtse sbyor mtshon byed kyi chos brgyad bshad zin to/ /gsum pa mthar gyis nyu(ra ba lhagan par/ mthar gyis pa/ /rnam gsum rnam bcu/ zhes mdor bstan nas de lan lag gi sgos rgyas par ston par/ sbyin pa shes rab bar dag 99
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum badang / /nas/ mthar gyis pa yi bya bar bzhed/ /ces gsungs/ mthar gyis sbyor ba la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams gsum las/ dang bo ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa rim can du sgom pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ mthar gyis sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/gnyis pa ni/ dbye na/ bcu gsum yod de/ sbyin pa nas shes rab kyi bar drug dang / sangs rgyas tshos dge 'dun tshul khrims gtong ba lha bla ma rjes su dran pa drug dang ngo bo nyid med rtogs kyi bar bcu gsum 81da pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sa mtshams tshogs lam nas skad cig sbyor gyi snga rol bar du yod/ /bzhi pa skad gcig ma'i sbyor ba ni/ skad cig gcig mngon ljogos byang chub/ /ces mdor bstan nas/ rgyas bar ston par/ sbyin pa la sogs re res kyang / /nas/ de nyid skad cig gcig gis mthong / /zhes gsungs/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sgra don/ sa mtshams bzhi/ dang 〈sna ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa la 〈snams pa brtan po nab pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'gror mthar thug de/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dang / rgyun mtha'i ye shes dang / bar chad med pa'i tshesbyor gsum don gcig la 'phags yul na'ang 'dod tshul mang ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ dbye na/ ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad pa bzhi yod de/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i skad cig sbyor dang / rnam par smin pa'i skad cig sbyor dang / mtshan nyid med pa'i skad cig sbyor dang / gnyis su med pa'i skad cig sbyor dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ dang po ston par/ sgyin pa la sogs re res kyang / /nas/ rtogs pa 'di ni shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs/rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i zag med kyi sbyin pa nas dpe byad brgyad cu'i bar gyi yon tan gyi rigs rnams skad cig ma gcig la mngon du byed nus pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar shug de/ rnam par smin pa min pa'i skad cig sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ ma dag sa bdun du sgom gyi 100
don bdun cu'i mtha' daphyod/nus pa lhun 'grub ma smin pas de'i yul gyi ldog chas bstan pa yin te/ 'phags seng dang rje yab sras bzhi lnga'i dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir lte/ rgyan snang las/ gdul bya'i skye bo nyi ba'i ngor ldog pas dbye na rnam pa bzhir ji ltar bstan par mdzad pas so/ /zhes dang / gser 'phreng las/ skad cig sbyor de la mtshan nyid dam ldog pas phye na/ zhes dang / rnam bshad las kyang / ldog 'tshams mi 'dra ba'i mtshan nyid kyis nas ngo bo gcig la/ ldog pa tha dad pa rnam pa bzhica(/ /zhes then/ /gnyis pa rnam par smin pa'i skad cig sbyor ston par/ gang me+e chos dkar thams cad kyi/ /nas/ de me+e skad cig gcig ye shes/ /zhes gsungs/ rnam par smin pa'i zag med kyi sbyin sogs nas dpe byad brgyad cu'i bar gyi yon tan gyi rigs rnams skad cig ma gcig la mngon du byed nus pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'gror mthar thug de/ rnam par smin pa'i skad cig sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ 'di'i rnam par smin pa sa brgyad pa yan chad kyi yul gyi ldog pas bshad de/nyi snang las/ rnam par smin pa'i chos nyid kyis gnas skabs kyi zag pa med pa'i chos thams cad/ ces dang / rnam bshad las/ skad cig ma bzhi'i dang bo sa bdun pa man chad du rtsol bas lha/ (sta /tsho rdzu (ran+dha na ( lhagā dzosna gh+nā r+yaṃ shā phru sprapa drim r+sha ji pā ṭ+wāṃ ṭī sbya ṇā ṭ+wāṃ rdzun/ ༷pa rnam par ma smin par bshad pa'i phyir dang / shugs la sa brgyad pa yan chad rnam par smin tshul yang go nus pa'i phyir/gsum pa mtshan nyid med pa'i skad cig sbyor ston par/ sbyin pa la sogs spyod pa yis/ /nas/ skad cig ma ni gcig gis rtogs/ zhes gsungs/ sbyin 〈snags 〈snas thams cad bden stong du skad cig ma gcig la mngon sum du rtogs pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i sems dpa'i 101
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum barnal 'byor mthar thug de/ mtshan nyid med pa'i skad cig sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/bzhi pa gnyis su med pa'i skad cig sbyor ston par/ rmi lam dang ni de mthong nyid/ /nas/de nyid skad cig gcig gis mthong / /zhes gsungs/ chos thams cad gzung 'dzin rdzas tha dad du ma grub par skad cig ma gcig la mngon sum du rtogs nus pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug de/ gnyis su med pa'i skad cig sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ gsum pa ni/dus mtha'i bya ljags kyi skad cig ma gcig la sbyin sogs mngon sum du phyogs par ma 'khul ba'am/ yang dag par rtogs pas na skad cig ma gcig gis mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ste/dus mtha'i skad cig ma gcig gi yun la a bhi sa ma ya'i/ a lha mngon du phyogs pa dang / sa ma yang dag pa nye dri ma zad pas ma 'khral ba dang / a ya rtogs pa dang gzhal ba'i don yin pa'i phyir te/ nyi snang las/ mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i don ci zhe na/ mngon du phyogs pa ni mngon du rtogs pa'am sa ma gyi sgra ni nges par mngon par brjod pa'o/ /a ya ni rtogs pa la'o zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ bzhi lnga'i sa mtshams rgyun mtha' kho nar yod/ skad cig gcig gis mngon par ljags par byang chub pa legs par bshad zin rto/ /gsum pa 'bras bu chos sku ston par/thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni/ /nas/ rnam pa nyi shu bdun du bzhed/ /ces gsungs/ tshogs gnyis bsags stobs kyis thob pa'i mthar zug gi yon tan de/ 'bras bu tshos sku'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ bzhi yod de/ngo bo nyid sku/ ye shes chos t+t+waṃ/ sna ༵ (snro /blta / /sbyizhi sku ༷ paX sdidī spra/caX dwo nyi/ shā zi pa dz+nyo rnyi sdusdi r+shang ba/rjo/shā/ba//shā so/ /tshos sku zhes pas ye shes chos sku yang bstan rto/ /dang po ngo bo nyid sku ston par/thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni/ /nas/ de dag rang bzhin mtshan nyid can/ /zhes gsungs/ de la mtshan nyid/102
don bdun cu'i mtha'adaphyod/dbye ba/ sa mtshams gsum/ dang po ni/ rang bzhin gyis dag pa dang slo bur gyi dri mas dag pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i dbyings mthar thug de/ ngo bo nyid sku'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ dbye na/rang yin gyi rang bzhin rnam dag gi char gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid sku dang / slo bur rnam dag gi char gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid sku gnyis yod/ gsum pa ni/ sa mtshams sangs rgyas kyi sa kho nar yod/gnyis pa ni/ ye shes chos sku ston par/ byang chub phyogs mthun tshad med dang / /nas/chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs/ de la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams gsum/dang po ni/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa la stos nas gzigs pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes de/ ye shes chos sku'i mtshan nyid/ de dang rnam mkhyen don gcig/gnyis pa ni/ dbye na/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i zag med ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig yod de/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i byang phyogs so bdun sde tshan dang po dang / de'i tshad med bzhi sde tshan gnyis pa dang / de'i rnam thar brgyad sde tshan gsum pa dang / de'i snyoms 'jug dgu sde tshan bzhi pa dang / de'i zad par bcu lde tshan lnga pa dang / de'i zil gnon brgyad sde tshan drug pa dang / de'i nyon yongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin sde tshan bdun pa dang / de'i smon gnas mkhyen pa sde tshan brgyad pa dang / de'i mngon shes drug sde tshan dgu pa dang /de'i so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi sde tshan bcu pa dang / de'i lus sogs dag pa bzhi sde tshan bcu gcig pa dang / de'i dbang bcu sde tshan bcu gnyis pa dang / de'i stobs bcu sde tshan bcu gsum pa dang / de'i mi 'jigs pa bzhi sde tshan bcu bzhi pa dang / de'i bsrung ba med pa gsum sde tshan bco lnga pa dang / de'i dran pa nyer bzhag gsum sde tshan bcu drug pa dang / de'i sems can gyi don la bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i tshos nyid sde tshan bcu bdun pa dang / de'i sgo gsum sgya bag chags yang dag par bcom pa sde tshan bco brgyad pa dang / de'i skye bo kun la zugs rje che ba sde tshan bcu dgu pa dang / de'i sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad sde tshan nyi shu pa 103
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum badang / de'i mkhyen gsum sde tshan nyer gcig pa yin pa'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sa mtshams sangs rgyas kyi sa kho nar yod/gsum pa longs sku ston par/ mtshan ni sum cu rtsaganyis dang / /nas/ thub pa'i longs spyod rogs skur bzhed/ /ces gsungs/ de la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams gsum/ dang po ni/nges pa lnga'i cha nas bzhag pa'i sku de/ longs sku'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ sgras brjod kyis dbye na longs sku che chung gnyis yod/ dang po dang 'og min gyi longs sku don gcig /gnyis pa dang 'og min gyi sprul sku don gcig /gsum pa ni/ sa mtshams sangs rgyas kyi sa dang gnas 'og min kho nar yod pa'o/ /bzhi pa sprul sku ston bar/ gang gis srid pa ji srid par/ /nas/ thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad/ /ces gsungs/ de la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ nges pa lnga dang mi ldan pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i gzugs sku mthar zug de/ sprul sku'i mtshan nyid/ de dang longs skus spya | hūm̐ ñja gyi khyi ༷/ ༷ba//༷༷ ṭ+wāṃ//swo spya nāṃ two ༷ ༷༷ /dī// ༷༷ spya ṭ+wāṃ /mi/༷ ṭ+wāṃ spya mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams/ 'jug tshul/ yun tshad lnga las/ dang po ni/ rang rgyu rnam mkhyen gyi bdag rkyen las byung ba'i rnam dkar gyi yon tan de/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las kyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ dbye na nyer bdun yod de/ 'gro rnams zhi ba'i las la 'god pa nas/ myang 'das la 'god pa'i 'phrin las kyi bar nyer bdun yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ lam ma zhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod/ bzhi pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las gdul bya'i rgyud la 'jug tshul la mtha' yas pa yod de/ rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham par sku gsung zugs 104
don bdun cu'i mtha'adapyod/kyi 'phrin las nam mkha' ltar rgya che ba/ chu bo bzhin rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhid dus las mi yol ba dang dpag bsam sgya shing dang yid bzhin gyi nor bu bzhin du 'bad med lhun grub tu 'jug pa'i pyir/ lnga pa ni/ yun tshad sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las rgyun mi chad pa yin te/ 'khor ba ma stong bar du gdul bya'i rgyud la rgyun mi 'chad par sna tshogs 'jug pa de'i phyir/ rtsabar/ de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid 'di'i/ /las ni rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ /smras pa/ rgyal yum rin chen 'byung gnas legs bshad kyi/ /rlabs ldan sbyor bzhis phyogs bzhir rab bkang ba'i/ /sku bzhi'i bang rim mtho ba'i lhun po'i rtser/ /mkhyen gsum dbang po sum rtsen rol 'di mtshar/ /rgyun du mnyam bzhag 'dab brgya'i gdan bcas kyang / /rang bzhin chos longs sprul sku'i zhal bzhi las/ /chos kyi gser 'khor bskor ba'i bcu gnyis spyan/ /'gro la rtsol mdzad tshangs pa mtshog des skyongs/ /lhag bsam sa srung steng rnyi sno k+ṣiṃ dī sno /r+shakārnyi sdidī (dī/ two hūm̐ /༈ rdzu ༵ /( rmold/ngo/༵ ༈sna rdoX gh+nā ༵ dzo bhe+e sna (( ches gsal ba'i/ /legs bshad mi pham bla ma'i zhal lung 'di/ /thub bstan phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i ched bskrun pa'i/ /'gro ba'i lam bzang snang ba 'bar gyur cig /de skad smras pa mang thos 'jam dbyangs zhal/ /bzhad pa rab rgyas 'jigs med rdo rje yis/ /dga' ba brgya ldan bshad snropa )shān+dha paX zhi/nga/ paspri nādhi stan nasna pa'e zlozlo shāng ༷su/rnyi ༈ spya/ 〉pa bstanā snashā g.yas su 'khyil ba'i chos grwa las/ /chos sbyin bdud rtsi'i gru char 'di phab bo/ /sarba maṅga laṃ/105
106
rilaphro/ /blo rig gi rnam gzhag nyung gsal legs bshad gser gyi phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs 31/ /na mo shrī mañca rtokhu ya swa ra swa ṭ+wāṃ tsa ma hā dhī me bra ya ṭ+wāsrid zhi'i phun tshogs kun bskyed rgyal rnams dang / /blo gter 'jam dbyangs yab yum la btud de/ /blo la gzhan sde'i brtags dang byis rnams kyi/ /'ol tshod mun bsal blo gros 'bum bzhad bya/ /de la 'dir slo rig gi rnam bzhag bshad pa la/ yul can blo dang / yul gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ lung 'god pa dang / de'i don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang rje'i blo'i don 'chad par/ rnam 'grel tshad ma grub pa'i le'u las/ lus rmya phul byung 'grib med par/ /blo yi byed pa'i khyad par gyis/ /shes rab la sogs phul byung dang / /'grib pa dag tu gyur pa yin/ /zhes byung / gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid/ rnam grangs/ dbye ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ rig pa de blo'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ shes rab dang tshad ma lta bu/ de gnyis chos can/107
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum barig pa'i don yod de/ yul 'char ba dang snang ba de yul de rig pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam grangs yod de/ blo dang shes pa dang rig pa dang gsal ba rnams don gcig pa'i phyir/shes pa'i mtshan nyid yod de/ gsal ba'i be+em min de de yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las/de'i pyir nged kyi slo rang nyid/ /gsal ba'i ngo bo rab gsal zhing / /zhes byung / yang rgyas par brjod na rang yul snang ba'i rig pa yin pa de/ rang blo yin pa'i mtshan nyid/ rnam 'grel las/de ltar blo la blo 'dod na/ /blo ni rang nyid rig par grub/ /ces so/ /rang yul gsal ba'i be+em min yin pa de/ rang shes pa yin pa'i mtshan nyid/ rnam 'grel las/ rang nyid rab tu gsal phyir don/ /de yi ngo bo rab gsal yin/ /zhes dang / dbu ma rgyan rang 'grel las/ shes pa ni gsal ba yin na gsal bar ma gyur te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /be+em min zhes pa 'gal zla'i tshig yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ shes pa zem min log pa ste/ /zhes dang / dbu ma rgyan las/ rnam shes be+em po'i rang bzhin las/ /bzlog par rab tu skye ba lte/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir kha cig na re/ rig pa'i mtshan nyid yul gyi rnam pa shar ba'i blo zhes zer ba dang /rang rig la yul gyi rnam pa mi 'char zer ba nang 'gal la/ kha cig na re/ rang rig chos can/rang yul snang ba'i blo yin par thal/ rig pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rang rig yin pa'i phyir/rtags khas/ 'dod na/ rang yul gyi rnam pa shar bar thal/ rang yul snang ba'i phyir na ma khyab/khyab bar thal/ rang yul gyi rnam pa snang ba'i pyir/ der thal/ rang yul snang ba'i phyir na yang ma khyab/ de gsum la 'dod mi nus te/ yul sgya 'dra rnam ma shar ba'i phyir/ der thal/ yul yul can gyi gnyis snang nub pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rang rig yin pa'i phyir/ khyab lte/ dbu ma rgyan las/ de yi rang gi rig pa ni/ /bya dang byed pa'i dngos por min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ byas pa la kho na re/ de la rang gi yang rnam pa ma shar bar thal/ rnam med kyi shes pa yin 108
slo rig mtha'adaphyod/pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rgyan rang 'grel las/ rnam pa dang bcas pa'i shes pa'i tshul las brjod pa lta bur/ rang rig pa la ni de lta bu'i rnam par bzhag pa mi 'thad de/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/ yul yul can gyi gnyis snang med pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na rnam bcas kyi shes pa ma yin par thal/ rang ngam yul gang gi yang rnam pa mi snang ba'i phyir/ rtags khas/'don na/ 'dzin rnam yang ma yin par thal lo/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ sngo snang dbang shes kyi sngon po'i rnam pa lta bu bzung rnam dang gzhan rig gi shes pa dang / myong tsam rang rig dang 'dzin rnam yin pa'i pyir te/ rigs rgyan las/ sngo snang dbang shes lta bu la yul gyi rnam pa shar ba'i cha dang / myong tsam gyi cha gnyis yod pa'i dang po bzung rnam dang / gnyis pa ni rang rig mngon sum mo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de sogs zhib cha mang / yang bod kyi rtog ge'i dbang po kha cig gi gsung las/ yul rig par bya ba blo'i mtshan nyid zer na/ skyes bu chos can/ slo yin par thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ rtags sla/gsum pa ni/ dbye ba drug yod de/rtogs blo dang ma rtogs pa'i blo gnyis su dbye ba dang /blo rig bdun du dbye ba dang / tshad ma dang tshad min gnyis su dang /rtog bcas rtog med gnyis su dang / mngon rjes gnyis su dang / sems sems smyung gnyis su dbye ba dang drug las/dang po la/ rtogs pa'i blo ni tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ nges pa rnams kyis ma nges la/ /de ni ji ltar de yul yin/ /zhes byung / rtogs pa'i slo la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ so so'i don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ blo de'i byed pa la brten nas chos de la nges pa 'dren nus pa/ blo des chos de rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid yin te/ blo des chos de nges pa na rang gi bzlog zla'i sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i phyir te/ dper na sgra mi rtag par nges pa'i rjes dpag gis sgra la rtag 'dzin gyi slo 'dogs gcod pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las/ nges pa dang ni 109
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum baslo 'dogs yid/ /gnod bya gnod byed ngo bo'i pyir/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de la dbye na/ dngos rtogs dang / shugs rtogs gnyis las/ blo de la yul de'i rnam pa shar ba'i sgo nas rtogs pa de/ blo des yul de dngos su rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sngon 'dzin dbang mngon gyis sngon po rtogs pa dang / sgra byas par dngos su rtogs pa'i rjes dpag gis sgra byas bar rtogs pa lta bu yin no/ /dngos su rtogs pa la mngon sum du rtogs pas ma khyab ste/ sgra mi rtag par dngos su rtogs pa'i rtog pa yod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ mngon sum du rtogs na yul de gsal bar snang bas khyab pa'i phyir/ rnam 'grel las/ gsal bar snang ba can blo gang / /de ni de la rtog med 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gong gi ma khyab mtshams kyi rtags grub ste/ de rtogs pa'i rjes dpag yod pa'i phyir/ khyab lte/ rnam 'grel las/ shes gang gang la sgra don 'dzin/ /de ni de la rtog pa yin/ /zhes dang / mngon sum le'u las kyang / rtog pa'i dra ba rnam bsal bas/ /gsal ba nyid du snang ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dngos rtogs shugs rtogs kyi tshul la yang / tshad ma dang tshad min gyis dngos rtogs shugs rtogs kyi tshul gnyis yod/ tshad mas dngos dang shugs la rtogs tshul la yang gsum yod de/ spyir tshad mas dngos su dang shugs la rtogs tshul dang / mngon sum tshad mas dngos su dang shugs la rtogs tshul/ rjes dpag tshad mas dngos su dang shugs la rtogs tshul gsum yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de/ tshad ma de yul de la blo kha phyogs shing rnam pa shar ba'i stobs kyis rjes su slo gzhan la stos med du nges pa rang stobs kyis 'dren pa ni/ tshad ma des yul de dngos su rtogs pa'i don yin/ yul de la da lta slo kha ma phyogs kyang / tshad ma des rang gi gzhal bya dngos su 'jal stobs kyis yul de la skabs dang mthun par slo 'dogs bcad tshar bas phyis blo kha phyogs tsam gyis tshad ma gzhan la ltos med du nges pa 'dren pa de/ tshad ma des yul de shugs rtogs 110
blo rig mtha'adaphyod/kyi don yin pa'i pyir/ 'di la'ang zhib cha dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ mngon sum tshad mas dngos rtogs dang shugs rtogs kyi don gnyis yod de/ mngon sum de la rang gi gzhal bya de'i rnam pa dngos su shar nas gzhal bya de la sgro 'dogs gcod pa ni/ mngon sum gyi tshad mas gzhal bya de dngos su rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid/dper na mtshan gzhi sngon 'dzin mngon sum tshad ma la sngon po'i rnam pa gsal bar shar nas sngon bo la slo 'dogs gcod pa lta bu yin/ mngon sum gyi tshad ma des rang gi gzhal bya de'i rnam pa dngos su shar nas dngos su gzhal bya de la sgro 'dogs bcad stobs kyis rang la rnam pa ma shar ba'i chos gzhan la'ang sgro 'dogs gcod pa de/ chos gzhan de mngon sum gyi tshad ma des shugs la rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi dper na bum pas dag pa'i sa phyogs kyi rnam pa dngos su shar nas nges pa drangs stobs kyis de'i bum med kyi rnam pa ma shar yang bum pa yod pa'i slo 'dogs bcad cing blo kha phyogs tsam gyis bum med du nges par 'gyur ba lta bu yin pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/ rjes dpag gis dngos rtogs dang shugs rtogs kyi don gnyis yod de/rjes dpag des rang gi gzhal bya de'i don sgyi shar ba'i sgo nas gzhal bya de la sgro 'dogs gcod pa ni/ rjes dpag de'i dngos gzhal gyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra mi rtag rtogs kyi rjes dpag la sgra mi rtag pa'i don sbyi dngos su shar ba'i sgo nas sgra rtag 'dzin gyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa lta bu/ de la rang gi gzhal bya de'i don spyi shar ba la sgro 'dogs bcad stobs kyis rjes dpag de la don sgyi ma shar ba'i chos gzhan la'ang slo 'dogs gcod pa de/ rjes dpag des shugs kyis chos gzhan de rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra mi rtag rtogs kyi rjes dpag gis sgra rtag par med pa'i don sgyi ma shar yang sgra la rtag pa yod pa'i sgro 'dogs 111
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum babcad cing blo kha phyogs tsam gyis tshad ma gzhan la stos med du sgra rtag par med par nges pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ rtog pa de la chos de'i don sgyi shar ba ni/ rtog pa de la chos de'i rnam pa shar ba'i don yin no/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshad min gyis dngos shugs kyi rtogs tshul gnyis yod de/ sgro 'dogs gsar du mi gcod kyang lhag ma rnam pa shar ba'i sgo nas rtogs pa de dngos su rtogs pa dang / rnam pa ma shar kyang rtogs pa shugs rtogs kyi don yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de la dbye na/ yid daphyod dang bcad shes gnyis sogs yod de/blo lngar dbye ba'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /mtha'adapyad pa la kha cig na re/ blo des chos de rang dus su rtogs na chos de la rang dus su nges pa 'dren pas khyab zer na/ bum pas dag pa'i sa phyogs 'dzin pa'i dbang mngon chos can/ khyod kyis bum med la rang dus su nges pa 'dren par thal/ khyod kyis de rtogs pa'i phyir te/ khyod kyis de shugs la rtogs ba'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sems can gyis nges shes kyis kyang de ltar 'dren par thal/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi de yin pa'i pyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ khyod kyi byed pas rang gi rjes su bar ma chod par nges shes 'dren pa'i phyir/ der thal/ nges shes mi 'dra ba gnyis cig car du rgyud gcig la mi rung ba'i phyir/ rnam 'grel las/ rtog gnyis cig car mthong ba med/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du sgra mi rtag rtogs pa'i rjes dpag gis sgra rtag med la yang rang dus su nges pa 'dren par thal lo/ /des de rtogs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na sngar ltar ro/ /yang kha cig na re/ blo de la yul de'i rnam pa shar nas rtogs pa ni/ des yul de rtogs pa'i don zer na/ blo des rtogs na de'i dngos rtogs kyis khyab par thal lo/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de'i shugs rtogs yod pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig na re/ blo des yul de 112
slo rig mtha' daphyod/rtogs na de la sgro 'dogs gcod pa'am bcad pas khyab zer na/ bcad shes gnyis chos can/rang gi gzhal bya la sgro 'dogs gcod par thal lo/ /de rtogs pa'i phyir/ rtags sla/ 'dod na/ yulade la slo 'dogs khyod kyis mi gcod par thal/ tshad ma snga mas bcad zin pa'i phyir/gzhan yang / yid daphyod chos can/ der thal/ rang gi rtogs bya rtogs pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ khyod kyis the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs mi gcod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ yid daphyod yin pa'i phyir/yang kha cig na re/ ma 'khrul pa'i blo yin na rang gi gzhal bya rtogs pas khyab zer na/ snang la ma nges pa'i mngon sum gsum po re re nas chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/chos can de yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ma rtogs pa'i blo la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ so so'i don bshad pa gsum/ dang bo ni/ rang gi gzhal bya la nges pa 'dren mi nus pa'i blo yin pa de/ rang ma rtogs pa'i blo'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na ma rtog /log rtog /ze tshom gsum yod/ dang po la dbye na/ snang la ma nges pa'i blo dang / rtog med log shes gnyis yod/ rang gi 'jug yul du gyur pa'i rang mtshan gsal bar snang ba yang yin/ 'jug yul rang mtshan la nges pa 'dren mi nus pa yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun par gyur pa'i rig pa yin pa de/ rang nyid snang la ma nges kyi blo yin pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ snang la ma nges pa'i dbang mngon/ yid mngon/ rang rig mngon sum gsum yod/ dang po ni/ rang gi 'jug yul rang mtshan gsal bar snang yang nges pa 'dren mi nus pa'i dbang mngon yin pa de/ rang nyid snang la ma nges kyi dbang mngon yin pa'i mtshan nyid/dbye na gzugs 'dzin gyi dang / sgra 'dzin gyi dang / dri 'dzin gyi dang / ro 'dzin gyi dang / reg 'dzin gyi dbang mngon snang la ma nges kyi bar yang yod de/ rnam 'grel las/ rnam shes don gzhan zhugs pa yis/ /nus med don gzhan mi 'dzin phyir/ /zhes dang / rnam 'grel mngon 113
